Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma are the two openers for South Africa. Fred Klaassen has been given the new ball and is raring to go. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! Netherlands have put up a competitive total on the board and they will look to give their all to defend it. South Africa, on the other hand knows that they just need to win to qualify for the semi-finals. Will they able to do it? Or will Netherlands cause an upset? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the second essay.

Stephan Myburgh is up for a chat. He says that South Africa is a good team. Adds that they are happy with 158 runs, but they could have got to 170 runs with the start they got. Mentions that it was a bit diificult to play the slower balls and further says that they have defended these kind of total earlier and they can do it again.

South Africa will be disappointed with their bowling effort, but they have enough quality to chase this total down. Anrich Nortje was the pick of their bowlers with his amazing spell of one for ten in his four overs. If not for him, they would have been chasing something around 175. Kagiso Rabada had a rare off day. South Africa need to get these runs to book their place in semi-finals.

Netherlands have put up a strong batting performance but they know that they could have got 10-15 runs more. However, 158 is still a good total and their bowlers need to be at their best to defend this one against a star-studded South African batting line-up. Stephan Myburgh and Max O'Dowd started really well and scored at a brisk rate. After they got out, Tom Cooper took the responsibilty to control the middle overs and Colin Ackermann finishes things nicley with quick-fire 41 off just 26 balls.

SIX! Colin Ackermann finishes the innigs in style! 15 runs from the over! Wayne Parnell bowls this full again and on the pads, Colin Ackermann flicks it wristily over the deep mid-wicket fence for another biggie. Netherlands ends on 158 for 4!
Wayne Parnell bowls another good yorker, around off, Colin Ackermann swings at it but misses.
This is pitched up, on leg, Colin Ackermann tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
SIX! BANG! Wayne Parnell goes fuller and on the leg stump line, Colin Ackermann gets his front leg out of the way and whips it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
A slower one, short of a length and on middle, Scott Edwards pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Wayne Parnell nails the yorker, on off, Scott Edwards is a bit late to get down his bat and misses.
Wayne Parnell is ready to the bowl the last over.
Short again and on middle, Colin Ackermann shuffles across and pulls it towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Short and on middle, angling in, Scott Edwards nudges it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Same shot, same result! Kagiso Rabada bowls this on a good length again, on middle this time, Scott Edwards goes for the reverse scoop again, but gets a top edge over the keeper for a boundary.
FOUR! Innovative and effective! This is on a good length and on off, Scott Edwards reverse scoops it towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Full again and down the leg side, Colin Ackermann flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Up and over! Kagiso Rabada bowls this full and on middle, Colin Ackermann stays there and smashes it over mid on for a boundary.
Kagiso Rabada to bowl the penultimate over.
Short of a length and on off, angling in, Colin Ackermann gets cramped and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Anrich Nortje bangs in a sharp short delivery, on middle, Colin Ackermann goes for the ramp shot but cannot connect.
A full toss now, on middle, Colin Ackermann goes for the scoop but miscues it towards fine leg for a single.
On a length and on middle, Colin Ackermann slaps it down to long on for a single.
Full and on middle, Scott Edwards works it towards deep square leg for a single.
Scott Edwards comes out the middle now.

OUT! TIMBER! Anrich Nortje gets his first wicket! He bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Bas de Leede makes room to play at it, but fails to reach it and misses as the ball goes through and rattle the stumps. A struggle from Bas de Leede comes to an end.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Netherlands! This is full and down the leg, Colin Ackermann flicks it wide of deep square leg where the fielder dives to his left, but the ball hits his knees and goes over the fence for a boundary.
A slower one, full and on middle, Colin Ackermann waits for it and whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Lungi Ngidi bangs in a short delivery, on middle, Colin Ackermann slashes at it but missses.
Short and on middle, Colin Ackermann pulls it over mid on for a couple of runs.
On a length and on off, Bas de Leede makes room and steers it towards deep point for a single.
This is on a hard length and on middle, angling in, Colin Ackermann flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Five dots to end the over! This is short of a length and on middle, Bas de Leede lets it go to the keeper.
Anrich Nortje bowls a slower bouncer now, on middle, Bas de Leede decides to go for the pull shot but withdraws at the last moment.
This is short again and on middle and leg, skids through the surface with extra bounce, Bas de Leede leaves it alone at the end.
A slower one now, full and on off, Bas de Leede only manages to knock it back to the bowler.
Anrich Nortje bangs this short, on off at 150 clicks, Bas de Leede looks to play at it but gets beaten.
This is on a good length and on off, Colin Ackermann slaps it towards mid off for a single.
Bas de Leede walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Keshav Maharaj gets the last laugh and sends Tom Cooper back to the hut. He bowls this slower through the air, on leg, Tom Cooper goes for the sweep again, but gets a top edge towards leg slip region. Quinton de Kock calls for it and takes a comfortable catch. Netherlands lose their third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Brilliant shot! This is flighted, full and on middle, Tom Cooper goes down and slog-sweeps it wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Quicker, full and on leg, Colin Ackermann goes for the sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads as the ball rolls to the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Shorter in length and on off, Tom Cooper punches it towards deep point for one.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Colin Ackermann tucks it towards deep mid-wicekt for a single.
Short and outside off, Colin Ackermann cuts it uppishly but on the bounce towards cover.
This is pitched up, on off, Colin Ackermann chips it down to long off for a single.
Short of a length and on off, Colin Ackermann forces it towards cover.
Pulls his length back a bit, on middle, Tom Cooper makes room and cuts it towards deep pont for single.
Goes fuller and on leg, Colin Ackermann clips it towards deep square leg for a run.
Back of a length and on middle, Colin Ackermann pushes it back to the bowler.
EDGED AND FOUR! Wayne Parnell bowls this on a good length and outside off, Colin Ackermann goes to push it away but gets a thick outside edge towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Short and on middle, Colin Ackermann tucks it towards long on for a single and gets off the mark.
Floated, full and on middle, Colin Ackermann blocks it back to the bowler.
Colin Ackermann comes out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! Keshav Maharaj gets his first wicket and South Africa finally breaks the partnership. Keshav Maharaj flights this up, on off, Max O'Dowd tries to go inside out and loft it towards the deep extra cover region, but hits it much straighter towards long off where Kagiso Rabada takes a good catch and throws the ball into the ground in frustration. Netherlands two down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Kagiso Rabada b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter, full and on off, Tom Cooper eases it towards long on for a run.
SIX! What a shot! This is tossed up, full and on off, Tom Cooper goes for the reverse sweep and smokes it over the deep point fence for a biggie.
A bit short and on off, Tom Cooper goes back and pushes it towards cover.
Keshav Maharaj (2-0-13-0) is back on.
This is on a good length and on off, Max O'Dowd makes room to play at it but misses.
Short and outside off, Tom Cooper punches it wide off deep point where the fielder does well to stop it from going to the boundary. Three runs taken!
A slower one, full and on off, Tom Cooper is early into his shot and chips it over point for a couple of runs.
This is on a good length and on leg, Tom Cooper goes for the scoop but cannot connect.

FOUR! Good shot! Kagiso Rabada bowls this a bit fuller and on middle, Tom Cooper heaves it towards the vacant deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. Keshav Maharaj gave chase and dived but could not stop it.
On a length and on off, Tom Cooper blocks it out.
Darts this one full, on leg, Max O'Dowd lofts it wide of long on for a brace.
Flatter, full and on midle, Tom Cooper heaves it towards deep square for a single.
Short and on middle, Max O'Dowd clips it towards deep mid-wicket.

Floated, full and on off, Max O'Dowd goes for the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW, but the finger stays down. Temba Bavuma goes for the review. UltraEdge shows no bat involved and Ball Tracking shows that it is pitching outside leg. South Africa lose their review.
Dropped! A bit short and on middle, Tom Cooper moves back and smashes it back towards the bowler where Aiden Markram lets it through his hands. A single is taken.
SIX! Brilliant shot! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Tom Cooper goes down and slogs it over the deep mid-wicekt fence for a biggie.

Drinks! Netherlands got off to a flying start with both their openers scoring at a brisk rate and they have a good platform at the halfway stage. Stephan Myburgh fell, but they have continued the runs. South Africa need wickets and they need it quickly. An exciting session of cricket awaits us.
A dot to end the over! This is shorter in length and on off, Max O'Dowd guides it towards point.
SIX! BANG! Keshav Maharaj bowls this short and on middle, Max O'Dowd moves back and pulls it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Tossed up, on off, Max O'Dowd pushes it towards cover.
Quicker one, on off, Max O'Dowd mistimes his cut back to the bowler.
Short again and on off, Tom Cooper cuts it towards cover where the fielder dives over the ball. A single is taken.
Short and outside off, Tom Cooper punches it wide of deep point where Anrich Nortje covers ground to his left and stops it. Two runs taken!
Flatter and on middle, Tom Cooper works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated, full and on middle, Max O'Dowd tucks it towards square leg for a run.
Flighted and around off, Tom Cooper cuts it through point for a single and gets off the mark.
Tom Cooper walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Aiden Markram provides the breakthrough for South Africa! He tosses this one up, full and on off, Stephan Myburgh goes down and tries the slog-sweep, but hits it too flat and it goes straight into the hands of Rilee Rossouw who is stationed at deep mid-wicket. Netherlands lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Rilee Rossouw b Aiden Markram

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full and on off, Max O'Dowd comes down the track and drives it towards long off for a single.
This is fired full and down the leg side, Max O'Dowd leaves it alone. Wided.

Aiden Markram starts with a tossed up delivery, full and on middle, Max O'Dowd goes for the reverse sweep but misses and gets rapped on his pads. There is a huge appeal for LBW, but turned down. Temba Bavuma takes the review after some discussions. UltraEdge shows no bat involved and Ball Tracking indicates that wickets is umpire's call. Max O'Dowd survives!
Spin from both ends as Aiden Markram comes into the attack.
Floated, full and on off, Stephan Myburgh tries the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Keshav Maharaj continues with short deliveries, on middle, Max O'Dowd pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and on off, Max O'Dowd punches it straight to covers.
Tossed up, full and outside off, Max O'Dowd moves across and goes for the sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Short again and around off, Max O'Dowd makes room and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Keshav Maharaj starts with a short delivery, on middle, Stephan Myburgh moves back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
We will see some spin now as Keshav Maharaj is ready to bowl.
Anrich Nortje with another sharp short delivery, on middle, Stephan Myburgh goes for the pulls shot, but gets a top edge onto his helmet and towards fine leg for one.
On a length and on off, Stephan Myburgh mistimes his cut onto the ground.
Anrich Nortje bangs in a bouncer, on leg, Max O'Dowd gets hurried and awakwardly pulls it towards mid-wicket for one.
Anrich Nortje serves this back of a length and around off, Stephan Myburgh punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Length again and on on middle, skidding through, Max O'Dowd looks to block it, but gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single.
This is on a good length and on middle, Max O'Dowd knocks it to the leg side. Anrich Nortje has been really good so far.
On a length and on off, Max O'Dowd guides it through backward point for a single. Netherlands are on 48 for none at the end of the Powerplay.
FOUR! Max O'Dowd gets into the act now! Lungi Ngidi bowls this short and outside off again, Max O'Dowd frees his arms and smashes it over point for a boundary.
Short of a length and outside off, Max O'Dowd cuts it over point for couple of runs.
Full and outside off, slower too, Max O'Dowd lobs it up over mid off for a brace.
This is on a hard length and outside off, Stephan Myburgh steers it past point for a single.
FOUR! Stephan Myburgh is dealing with boundaries here! Lungi Ngidi bowls this full and on middle, Stephan Myburgh lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
BEATEN! Anrich Nortje serves this on a hard length, on middle at 146 clicks, shoots up off the surface, Max O'Dowd looks to play at it but gets beaten.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, Max O'Dowd blocks it out.
Anrich Nortje bowls this short of a length and outisde off, Max O'Dowd looks to cut it away but misses.
A slower one now, on a length and on off, Stephan Myburgh knocks it towards short cover for a single.
Touch fuller and on off, Stephan Myburgh bunts it onto the ground and towards point.
Anrich Nortje starts with a pitched up delivery, on off, Stephan Myburgh clears his front leg and drives it firmly, but straight to covers.
Anrich Nortje comes into the attack now.
This is full and on middle, Max O'Dowd chips it down towards the vacant long on region for a brace.
Back of length and on leg, Stephan Myburgh pulls it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Great timing! This is short again and on middle and leg, Stephan Myburgh picks up the length early and whips it towards the deep square leg fence for another boundary.
FOUR! A poor delivery and rightly punished! Lungi Ngidi lands this short and down the leg side, Stephan Myburgh just helps it towards the fine leg fence for a boudnary.
This is on a hard length and on middle, angling into the batter, Stephan Myburgh goes for the pull shot but gets an inside edge onto the thigh pads as the ball goes nowhere.
Lungi Ngidi starts with a good-length delivery, on off, Stephan Myburgh pushes it towards cover.
Lungi Ngidi replaces Kagiso Rabada.
Goes full again and on off, Max O'Dowd blocks it out towards point.
Wayne Parnell loses his line and serves this full delivery down the leg side, Max O'Dowd misses his flick. Wided.
This is pitched up and on off, Stephan Myburgh drives it towards point and gets across for a quick single.
Wayne Parnell bangs this short and on middle, Max O'Dowd gets hurried and miscues his pull shot towards mid-wicket for one more.
Fuller one and around leg, Stephan Myburgh nudges it towards deep square leg for a run.
This is back of a length and on off, Max O'Dowd guides it towards third man for a single and gets off the mark.
On a length and on off, Max O'Dowd knocks it towards point.
FOUR! Third boundary of the over! This is full and outside off, Stephan Myburgh stays there and thrashes it past cover for a four more runs. 12 runs from the over!
Length again and on off, shaping away, Stephan Myburgh gets beaten on the outside edge.
BEATEN! Kagiso Rabada bowls this on a good length and on off, angling away a bit, Stephan Myburgh looks to play at it but misses.
FOUR! Just over! Kagiso Rabada serves this a bit fuller and outside off, Stephan Myburgh slices it in the air and it goes just over the leaping Keshav Maharaj at point for a boundary.
On a length and on off, Stephan Myburgh pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! Nice shot! Kagiso Rabada bowls this on a hard length from around the wicket, on off, Stephan Myburgh drives it uppishly through covers for a boundary.
Kagiso Rabada to share the new ball.
This is full and on leg, Stephan Myburgh flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. 5 runs from the first over!
Back of a length and outside off, shaping further away, Stephan Myburgh slashes at it but cannot connect.
Goes a bit fuller and around off, shaping away, Stephan Myburgh looks to cut it away but misses.
Short of a length and outside off, Stephan Myburgh mistimes his cut onto the ground to the off side.

FOUR! Stephan Myburgh and Netherlands are underway in style! Wayne Parnell lands this short and on middle, sits up nicely, Stephan Myburgh stays there and pulls it towards the vacant deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Wayne Parnell starts with a good-length delivery, on off, Stephan Myburgh guides it towards point.

We are ready for action now! We can see the South Africa players in a huddle and they are taking their respective field positions. Stephan Myburgh and Max O'Dowd are the two openers for Netherlands. Wayne Parnell to start proceedings with the ball. Before that, the South African players take the knee to support BLM movement. We are ready to go. Let's play...
The umpires and players line up for the national anthems. It will be Netherlands' first followed by the national anthem of South Africa.

PITCH REPORT - Shaun Pollock is pitchside. He says that the square boundaries are on the shorter side and the batter will look to target that. Adds that it is dry surface and there is some moisture on it which could help the pacers at the start. However, if the batters get through the first few overs they can play their shots freely.

Scott Edwards, the captain of Netherlands says that they would have batted first. Adds that the weather looks clear and hopes that the pitch will be stay good throughout the game. Mentions that this is an important game for them in the context of the next World Cup. Informs that they are unchanged.

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa says that they will bowl first. Adds that they have gone with the extra seamer and will be looking to exploit the moisture in surface. Mentions that David Miller and Keshav Maharaj are back in the side. Ends by saying that they this is a must-win game for them and they need to execute their plans to correctly.

Netherlands (Unchanged Playing XI) - Stephan Myburgh, Max O'Dowd, Tom Cooper, Colin Ackermann, Bas de Leede, Scott Edwards (C) (WK), Roelof van der Merwe, Logan van Beek, Fred Klaassen, Paul van Meekeren, Brandon Glover.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Temba Bavuma (C), Quinton de Kock (WK), Rilee Rossouw, Aiden Markram, David Miller (In place of Tristan Stubbs), Heinrich Klaasen, Wayne Parnell, Keshav Maharaj (In place for Tabraiz Shamsi), Kagiso Rabada, Anrich Nortje, Lungi Ngidi.
TOSS - South Africa have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

South Africa  was the team to beat in this group until their defeat to Pakistan in the last game. They have been brilliant with the ball, and their batters are in good touch too. However, they got a reality check in the previous match and will look to get back to their usual best. They are the favourites in this game, but this T20 World Cup has seen quite a few upsets, and this could be another one. Let's see who comes out on top. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.
